verdict.rationale: Plaid IDV lets you configure no-code verification workflows whose conditional checks run automatically, such as running an extra check only if another fails or flags high risk. Its event webhooks (STEP_UPDATED, STATUS_UPDATED, RETRIED) let your own systems react without manual intervention. These automations, however, run only inside user-initiated verification sessions. Truly autonomous background processing would have to be built by the integrator on top of the webhooks and API. Missing for 10: scheduled or recurring background jobs, user-defined autonomous automations independent of a live session, documented automatic re-screening via the Monitor integration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
